what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from China in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 68691 Chinese asylum seekers in the United States, 68.9% of all asylum seekers from China.
Refugees from China, a separate group, live mostly in India, the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over East Turkestan territory in China with ETIM in 2008, and an interstate armed conflict between China and India in 2020.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 11810 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 147909, at the end of 2024 and was lower by the end of 2025; the main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
